about.title: Method & data
about.method: Stratified 80/20 split (seed 42). TabPFN-3.5 via tabpfn-client (TABPFN_API_KEY) with local fallback, vs CatBoost baseline. The agent predicts + explains (global signals × local z-score) + recommends in plain FR/EN.
about.data: 1000 rows × 189 tabular satellite + climate columns, binary Cropland target (0/1). Local copy in data/raw/, example in data/processed/sample_example.csv.
